asks: What do these words for what Silo does mean: rule, precaution, protective, alert?

sets.means: Data you set. It is triggered by a fact, so it is exact.
Data you set. It is triggered by a report or an opinion, so it can be wrong.
Said of an action that is neither granting nor destructive, so a wrong one costs only time.
What Silo raises for your attention.

suggest.why: The word is agreed; this meaning is the record's own word list, which carries no mark.
